statements.statement: ChauffeurNet employs a recurrent neural network (RNN) architecture that processes mid-level input representations to output driving trajectories.
ChauffeurNet integrates components like FeatureNet and AgentRNN with co-trained perception modules.
Mid-level representations facilitate training on both real and simulated data.
Mid-level representations enable closed-loop simulation testing prior to real-world deployment.
This approach supports iterative prediction refinement through recurrent feedback mechanisms.
